data.title: Top 3 Price Prediction: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Ripple – BTC consolidates near recent highs, ETH and XRP defend key bullish supports | FXStreet
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH) and Ripple (XRP) maintain a constructive outlook on Monday after gaining more than 3.4%, 4% and 4.8%, respectively, last week. BTC holds steady near $80,000 while ETH and XRP show resilience and defend key support zones.
